title: Unit Event — Competitive Fire! — Episode8 We'll Be Back

meta.Event Outline: When Vivid BAD SQUAD go for a meal with Ken, Taiga and the twins before their return to Japan, an unexpected reunion sparks a newfound fire in An.

rows.Line: The next day
Airport

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're finally going back to Japan.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We got to see you and Uncle Taiga perform in that event, Dad, and we heard illys and Embers sing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The time just flew by.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But we gained quite a lot during this trip.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We'll need to start getting ready for RUSH BEATS once we're back in Japan.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
You guys sound pretty motivated.
I'm glad to hear that you all had a good experience.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We got to do a bunch of stuff you can only do in the US, after all!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Getting to stay at the New York Academy of Music was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We also learned quite a lot during the sessions we got to do with the students from the academy.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I didn't think that we'd have time to, but we also got to do some sightseeing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, we did! And we got to check out a ton of recommended places that the locals really love.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Oh, it's the record company.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Sorry, I need to take this.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, see you in a bit!
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You're all finally retuning to Japan!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Luka! You came to see us?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, I wanted to see the United States one last time.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <This trip was so much fun. It's a shame to say goodbye.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It really is...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But we'll be back here before too long!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, that's right! Because you're going to perform in RUSH BEATS.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's right. I'm sure we'll face our share of obstacles...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But we'll just find a way over 'em.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Haha. That's the spirit!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That reminds me...
I kept forgetting to ask you this because things were always so chaotic, Luka.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Were you trying to ask me something the last time you came to see us?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, that? So...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. Your eyes were just twinkling so much, An.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You seemed so happy about meeting opponents you can give your all against and who you want to beat.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I wanted to tell you I could see it all over your face!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <They're different from your teammates and regular friends, but...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Rivals chase after the same dream and push each other to become better, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <So, I'm glad that you've found some good ones.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Me too!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I have a feeling that we're gonna have a lot of fun in the future!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, I'm also looking forward to... Huh?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hmmm...?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <They're too far away for me to clearly make out, but I think it's...>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?
Oh, there you guys are!
se_run_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? You're all here...?!

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Thank goodness! We made it just in time!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What are you guys doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line:
So...
Ken told us the time for your flight home.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Our plan was to get here a little earlier, but...

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: I'm so sorry!! I lost my phone along the way and it took ages to find it again...

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Oh, but we did end up finding it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. That must've been quite an ordeal...

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Haha. Fortunately, we were still able to make it in time to see you off.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Yeah. I know we're gonna see each other again soon, but... We're rivals striving together, after all.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I'm glad we get to see you guys one last time too.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: The next time we meet, we'll be opponents.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Haha! I'm so eager to battle against you guys that I can't stay still.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. I'm looking forward to it too.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Let's all give it everything we've got.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: You guys better be ready, because we'll be at another level by then!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's our line.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we don't plan on letting you hog all the glory.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! There's no way we're gonna just let you guys win!
se_walk_men_002_2

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Alright, I know how hard it is to say goodbye...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: But you lot are going to miss your plane if you don't get going.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, right...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, let's get going, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Have a safe flight!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks!
We'll see you guys again soon!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're definitely for sure gonna be back!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, see you all at RUSH BEATS!
